heard: Mariner 9 was the first probe to orbit another planet. It beat its twin, which crashed in the Atlantic. But on arrival, it found only a wall of dust. A global storm had swallowed the entire Red Planet. Two Soviet probes arrived, but couldn't adapt to the storm. They blindly snapped thousands of photos of pure dust. NASA engineers reprogrammed the ship from Earth in 1971. Mariner 9 waited months for the Martian sky to clear. It finally mapped massive volcanoes and 2,500-mile canyons. It succeeded even when the planet was hidden by dust.
